content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Clerk Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Clerk post at TMC?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Clerk position at Tata Memorial Centre is scheduled for 29 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend within the specified time frame.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Clerk position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Clerk post, candidates must have completed Graduation with a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Clerk position is 27 years. There might be age relaxations for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Clerk position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 23,870/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: Tata Memorial Centre is recruiting for a total of 5 vacancies for the Clerk position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their bio-data, recent passport size photograph, PAN card, Aadhar card, educational and experience certificates in Original and one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Tata Memorial Centre, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221005.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The selection process may involve a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test or Interview, depending on the number of candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
